geometry.corners: grid corners TL, TR, BR, BL of the board as it is to be READ, image continuous coords
geometry.pixelConvention: pixel (i, j) covers [i, i+1) x [j, j+1); its centre is (i+0.5, j+0.5)
geometry.prefilter: s = mean grid edge / 15; if s >= 2*pxPerSquare, box-downsample by floor(s / pxPerSquare), round half up
geometry.sampling: bilinear between pixel centres; neighbours outside the image contribute 0
geometry.canonical: pixel (x, y) samples H((x+0.5)/pxPerSquare - margin, (y+0.5)/pxPerSquare - margin), H: board square coords -> image
geometry.crop: square (r, c) = canonical[r*pxPerSquare : +cropSize, c*pxPerSquare : +cropSize], rounded half up to uint8

kind_logits.semantics: the PHYSICAL tile kind, or empty. Never an assigned face: faces are not visible and belong to reconstruction.

turn_logits.semantics: clockwise quarter-turns of the print as seen in the crop; undefined for empty squares. The board's reading side is the turn most tiles agree on.

passes: 1. Crop all 225 squares with the corners in ANY order. Softmax turn_logits; over squares whose kind is not empty, sum log p(turn = h) for h in 0..3. The side the board is read from is the h that wins: rotate the corner list by h (corners[h:] + corners[:h]).
2. Re-crop with the rotated corners. Now nearly every tile is upright; use kind_logits from this pass for evidence.
runtime.why: a ÷ turned 90° is nearly a + at 40 px per square; reading the board from its correct side first removes that ambiguity for every tile that sits upright
runtime.evidence: CellEvidence per square from softmax(kind_logits / temperature), top-K kept, remaining mass to unknown; CellEvidence.orientation from softmax(turn_logits)

unknown.apply: keep the 3 most probable classes; the remaining mass is `unknown` (cellEvidenceFromProbabilities does this)

model.architecture: SquareNet (depthwise-separable CNN; final feature map flattened, not pooled)

syntheticMetrics.note: SYNTHETIC-DOMAIN — held-out synthetic test set, calibrated
